video_title: LeBron, Maxey, JB...What About Joel Embiid? | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: New LeBron James teams always face early season growing pains
quotes.excerpt: There will be growing pains. There's always been growing pains with new LeBron James teams.
quotes.quote: The vibe is good because it's usually good. Every baseball team has hope on opening day, even though we know that baseball does not work like that. Everyone was saying all the right things, and that's great to hear because we've been to media days where people don't say the right things. When the pedal to the metal goes down and all of that happens in the first month or two of the season, there will be growing pains. There's always been growing pains with new LeBron James teams. There is always a bit of a rough start as everyone figures out what they're doing.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey served as a key sounding board for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: It was quite clear that Tyrese Maxey was his sounding board, really, in coming to the 76ers.
quotes.quote: The other takeaway I had was how much Tyrese Maxey played a role in LeBron James's decision. I don't think until we heard LeBron talk about it both on his podcast and then at media day, it was quite clear that Tyrese Maxey was his sounding board, really, in coming to the 76ers. He said I have a great relationship with Tyrese. He said we talked about it a lot, I picked his brain a lot, not only where he sees his career going, how he sees the franchise, how much he believes in the franchise, and if I was to come here, how does he see me fitting in.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James will transition to a point-forward role in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: He's point-forward LeBron here. He's operating as a playmaker. His assist numbers need to go up.
quotes.quote: LeBron adjusting is not going to be a big issue because I think he's coming into the situation with his eyes wide open. He knows that he's point-forward LeBron here. He's operating as a playmaker. His assist numbers need to go up. His shots, his points, they're probably going to go down. Minutes need to go down, maybe games played need to go down. He's been historically resistant to that, but I think he's going into the situation with his eyes wide open.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown knows how to fit into a new situation
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown knows how to fit into a particular situation. He knows how to be a 1A or 2.
quotes.quote: I'm also not overly concerned about Jaylen Brown either. Jaylen Brown knows how to fit into a particular situation. He knows how to be a 1A or 2, or whatever it may be that he was in Boston that he now is in Philadelphia. He obviously has a lot of confidence after what he did last season, but even though he didn't choose the 76ers, I think he's going to find a way to make it work.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid remains the central figure for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: When Joel Embiid is healthy, and he's out there, I think he's still going to expect to be the center of the universe.
quotes.quote: The wild card to me is Joel Embiid, because when Joel Embiid is healthy, and he's out there, I think he's still going to expect to be the center of the universe. When Joel Embiid is out there, he's still the process. He's still the guy that has been there the longest. He's still three years removed from being named the MVP. His body's broken down a lot since then, things have changed a lot since then, but what is Joel Embiid bracing for? What kind of role is he expecting with this group?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe's reduced role is a legitimate concern
quotes.excerpt: V.J. Edgecombe was on like the was ascendant and now he's like the fifth option on that team.
quotes.quote: I think V.J. Edgecombe is a problem too. I know LeBron kind of downplayed this like you guys think V.J. Edgecombe is going to disappear. I think that's a real concern. V.J. Edgecombe was on like the was ascendant and now he's like the fifth option on that team. So I think that's getting him his touches is probably a legitimate question or concern to have.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's weight loss signals a willingness to sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: Seeing him as slim as he was a few days ago told me a lot about his willingness to sacrifice.
quotes.quote: Seeing him as slim as he was a few days ago told me a lot about his willingness to sacrifice and fit in on this team, because he's going to need to move up and down the court in a way that we haven't seen him move up and down the court in a while. I've covered Joel pretty closely most of his career. He definitely wants to win. If you know the circumstances he came from, what he endured early in his career both with his family and then obviously with the injuries, this is a guy who had a lot of excuses to just quit and go home, and instead has just stuck with it.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers must manage Joel Embiid's touches and health
quotes.excerpt: Is Joel Embiid going to be okay with less touches? Is this one ball going to be enough?
quotes.quote: The thing that we have to remember about this 76ers team as we talk about is Joel Embiid going to be okay with less touches? Is this one ball going to be enough for everyone in Philadelphia? You have to think about how often a lot of these guys are going to play. You cannot assume perfect health with this team, especially with LeBron, especially with Joel. Both of them have had injuries that have knocked them out for, you know, six weeks at a time in recent years.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: The 76ers are built to be a dangerous playoff team
quotes.excerpt: This to me just screams of being a playoff team if they are healthy when the playoffs come around.
quotes.quote: This to me just screams of being a playoff team if they are healthy when the playoffs come around. They are going to be extremely dangerous. I think the regular season is not necessarily going to be an indication of what they do in the postseason.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's lateral movement is the key to defense
quotes.excerpt: I need to see how he moves laterally. That to me is the big thing.
quotes.quote: The weight loss doesn't really do much for me. I need to see how he moves laterally. That to me is the big thing, because beyond his needing him to be the offensive force that he's been, he's one of the best defensive players in the league when he's healthy. And that's what they need as much as anything.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid should not be shooting high-percentage three-pointers
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to see him beyond the three-point line at a higher percentage. He's a post guy.
quotes.quote: I know his shots will go down. I don't want to see him beyond the three-point line at a higher percentage. He's a post guy. He's one of the most dominant post players in the NBA. I don't want him drifting on the perimeter for spacing reasons. I don't want him drifting into the perimeter because there's too many guys playing at the mid-post or at the elbow. This guy's got to be in the post, drawing fouls, getting to the free throw line, just doing what he does best.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference is unpredictable until the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: The way I look at these teams this year, it really feels as if more than ever, we're not going to know.
quotes.quote: The way I look at these teams this year, it really feels as if more than ever, we're not going to know until the beginning of the postseason. The Knicks this past year were a great example of that. I feel like we are dealing with teams that have is Jason Tatum going to be really healthy? Then I'd be worried about Boston in the playoffs. If he has health issues like he's had, unfortunately, the past couple seasons, then yeah, they're going to be a great regular season team because it's Joe Mazzulla and the way that they tear through the regular season, but then the playoffs could be a very different animal.
